description:
Annotate a dashboard screenshot on Slide 1 of the presentation 'revenue_analysis.odp'. 

1. Draw a **Rectangle** around the red 'Q3' bar. Set the **Line Color** to Red and **Fill** to None (Transparent) so the bar is visible.
2. Add a **Callout** shape pointing to the Q3 bar with the text: 'Supply chain disruption'.
3. Draw an **Arrow** pointing from the top of the Q3 bar to the top of the Q4 bar.
